description: This source file contains unit tests for the AppState remote configuration functionality within a macOS application, specifically testing remote gateway configuration updates, token handling, and object token preservation in the application's state.

classes.name: AppStateRemoteConfigTests
classes.description: A struct defining suite of unit tests for remote configuration handling in AppState.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigSetsTrimmedToken
methods.description: Tests that a remote gateway config correctly trims whitespace from the token value.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigClearsTokenWhenBlank
methods.description: Tests that an empty or whitespace-only token clears the token value in the remote config.

methods.name: syncedGatewayRootPreservesObjectTokenAcrossModeAndTransportChangesWhenUntouched
methods.description: Ensures that object tokens are preserved across changes in mode and transport, maintaining secret references.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigReplacesObjectTokenWhenUserEntersPlaintext
methods.description: Checks that entering a plaintext token replaces the secret reference with the actual token string.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigClearsObjectTokenOnlyAfterExplicitEdit
methods.description: Verifies that secret references are only cleared when explicitly edited or cleared, not on minor changes.
